name: Omarchy Tablet Lockscreen Touch
author: Omid.Developer
description: On-screen touch keyboard for the Omarchy operating system on a keyboard-less tablet. Adds a real keypad to both screens where Omarchy asks for a password: a Quickshell session lock with password and fingerprint PAM flows, plus a matching SDDM login theme. Both type straight into the real password field. Tested on a Lenovo IdeaPad Miix 320 tablet.
